marks.gloss_en: Rava: but even if he slaughtered the olah and afterwards the chullin, he is exempt
R' Yochanan: consumption by the altar is called consumption
the verse speaks of two consumptions: one human consumption and one consumption by the altar
ואזדו לטעמייהו, דכי אתא רב דימי אמר... רבי יוחנן אומר: חייב -- R' Yochanan's forewarning ruling follows his ruling in Rav Dimi's case (kind svara: no support kind for לטעמייהו)
ואזדו לטעמייהו... וריש לקיש אומר: פטור -- Reish Lakish's forewarning ruling follows his ruling in Rav Dimi's case (kind svara)
those liable to death [who acted] unwittingly, and another matter -- R' Yochanan: liable

ופרת חטאת שחיטה שאינה ראויה היא? והתניא: רבי שמעון אומר: פרה מטמאה טומאת אוכלין הואיל והיתה לה שעת הכושר; ואמר רבי שמעון בן לקיש: אומר היה רבי שמעון, פרה נפדית על גבי מערכתה (= p_para_nifdeit_al_maarachta)
the baraita, R' Shimon: the heifer is susceptible to food impurity, since it had a time of fitness
the mishna: one who slaughters [one of mother and offspring] for idolatry -- the Sages obligate
Reish Lakish: they taught [the Sages' liability] only where he slaughtered the first for idolatry and the second for his table

R' Yochanan: rather, sometimes even [if] he slaughtered the first for his table and the second for idolatry he is liable -- e.g. where they forewarned him on account of 'it and its offspring' and did not forewarn him on account of idolatry
and Reish Lakish said: since were they to forewarn him he would be exempt, when they do not forewarn him he is also exempt
R' Yochanan [holds] liable, since they did not forewarn him
for had it taught us only this [oto ve'et beno and idolatry], Reish Lakish says it here; but in that [Rav Dimi's case] say he concedes to R' Yochanan
and had it been stated only of that, R' Yochanan says it there; but in this say he concedes to Reish Lakish -- [both] are necessary
one who slaughters and it became a carcass in his hand -- exempt on account of 'it and its offspring'
